notes.title: Surprise! Loadout Update 1.30.01
notes.notes:
The LOADOUT Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37598345/c2a491481c404cd6600a3328d852ff042339d771.png

What is a loadout anyway?
A loadout is an alternative kit for a character. I've introduced 4 Loadouts to start, with more to come!
The first four are:

 Dalton - Generalist
 Friday - Rabbithood
 Bingo - Cowboy
 Blaise - Punk


Each one offering a twist on the character's playstyle!
Loadouts are enabled in the Server Options here:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37598345/4d5df0a90c8aa375149f2f722ec65711d079ed62.png

After they've been enabled, players can choose a loadout when selecting a character:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37598345/fc62df36bb327d5dff4119393db1929dc3ea6051.jpg

Some of these loadouts include new weapons & Abilities! Starting with these 4 characters I will add at least one loadout to each character in the base roster.

I've also done some minor tweaks listed here:

Balance & Bug Fixes

Gwen

 Reduced Rock damage by 50%
 Reduced Fire DoT & Instant damage by 50%
 Fixed some bugs involving "Phantom" projectiles that might be a buff! Since the netcode was deleting some of her impacts.


Abigail

 Turrets now properly display a Red outline around them in FFA modes to enemies.


This update is live now! As always, we try to organize games in our discord, check the steam community pinned post for a link! Or in-game on the main menu. 

Much love, -Pandan

notes.title: Patch 1.28.01 - The Great Balance Patch
notes.notes:
The Great Balance Patch 
The goal of this patch was to just shake the game up a bit, lots of micro tweaks and adjustments for balance. We have an audience of a dozen or so people who play it every weekend on the discord community. So if you are interested in getting more involved, seek us out!

Character Adjustments

Abigail
+ Abigail turret max range reduction 9000 to 2500
+ Abigail's shotgun reduction by 1dmg per pellet

Gwen
+ Energy Drain on Gwen Speed Buff, 5 energy drain tick
+ Fire DoT on enemies reduced from 8+30 over 6 seconds) -> 8+18 over 6 seconds

Friday
+Healing Magnum Heal 50 -> 20
+Remove stomp "easter egg"
+Given stomp action (V key) deals 30 damage

Bingo
+ Melee damage reduction removed
+ Knockback from knife removed (Sort of a buff and nerf at the same time) Previously knocked people away from you slightly on hit, but also acted like a ministun

Dalton
+ Dalton's Rifle rework
+ 51 damage headshot + 40 damage over 4 seconds DoT effect

Charlie
+ Fixed Charlie's Ticket to Die exploit in Randomizer mode
+ Flying Claws Damage (buff) (max multiplier 10 to 12x) 
+ Flying Claws projectile Speed increased

Hemlock
Plummeter
+ Plummeter deals 5% of the fall distance in damage (about 30 damage from a gwen tornado height) 

Weapons

Pistol
+ Headshot multiplier reduction From 2.0x to 1.5x

Brutal Shot
+ Ministun removed (Had a micro knockback that served as a ministun)
+ Shifted 5 damage from AOE to Direct Hit (same damage direct hit) (same damage on direct hit; 45)

Minigun
+ Removed movement speed Slow while revving & firing (buff)

Rocket Launcher
+ 1 -> 2 cost per shot (nerf)

Long Shot
+ Reworked to projectile weapon
+ Lobs a slug at a fast speed in an arc, dealing 60 damage on body shot (No headshots)


Random
+ Reduce mega weapon likelyhood on randomizer (Mega weapons now have a chance to occupy the last slot of every character at 10% chance)
+ BOT Navigation was broken on Map_Ancient (Fixed)

• Friday's Fast fall is removed (Crouch while mid air) 
Friday's melee combo was fun to do, but it was extremely hard to counter given how fast she could land on the ground and do it. This will allow some counter play to her poison->Kick combo.

notes.notes:

Hey All, As my discord server has been well aware for months now, December (This month!) 
Is the last month Fadeout is receiving content updates.

https://discord.com/invite/fadeout
Also be sure to join us on the LAST PLAYTEST scheduled for 12/18 2:00 PM PST!
We will be raffling & offering prizes, including Steam giftcards to participants!

1.00.00
To celebrate this patch, I've collaborated with the Brickadia developers to add fun toy-brick map to Fadeout!

But why?
For those that don't know, Fadeout owes a lot of its roots to Blockland (2007), an online brick building game.
I used to create mods, and host Deathmatch servers on Blockland very frequently as a kid.|
Well fast forward 14 years later, and I'm much older at 29, and working in the games industry!

Modding was a huge part of why I decided to pursue a career in games. 
So what a better way to 'end' fadeout development than with a homage to my roots.

Brickadia
So what is Brickadia? Well, Brickadia is a spiritual successor to Blockland built on modern game engine code. (Unreal4) 

Brickadia is still in development, but with their help I was able to export a map created in the game for us in Fadeout! It's a strange cross over, but it did yield a very fun map.
Over the last few weeks, the discord server has been helping me test this map + some other 'last minute' changes to the game.

notes.title: Last Patch will be Mid December 2021
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37598345/3b4a7546173cf4e06f7c9127f2e2552553a97d34.png

Hi all, 

This blog isn't read very much. But its a nice place for me to have bigger announcements.
If you are already in our discord server, you are probably aware of my recent announcement for stopping content development on Fadeout: Underground.

What does this mean for the game?

Put Simply:


 No more content updates, only critical bug fixes.
 Dedicated servers for the game will remain up for as long as I can afford them, but the game will still be playable without them.
 The paid DLC will remain paid, see it as a donation box. And I really do appreciate the people who have purchased it to support the game. It has allowed me to commission some awesome artwork for the game in the past.
 The last update will be Mid-December 2021


What does this mean for the Devs going forward?

By the time the final release in December comes, I would have spent over 3 years working on the game. Every day after work, and nearly every weekend I've poured hours of my own time & money into this game. And it's been the most fun and love filled hobby I've ever had.

HOWEVER. I want to move on, I want to make new things, new games. So I do invite you to stick around and see what I will be up to.

What does this mean for the discord server?

Shortly after the 1.0 release in December, I will be transforming the discord into a Studio server that is about my creations. Fadeout: Underground included. So we will still have a place to hang out and chill, and probably play some games of Fadeout from time to time.

Thank you everyone for the love and support. If you have any questions about my decision, I'm available via DM most of the time on discord. Pandan#0001

notes.title: November 18th Balance Patch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37598345/be6c49f774393944e72c03f85661457cfd654de6.png
Patch Notes:
If you're reading this, the patch is now live!

Dedicated Server

Self restarts after 9 rounds have passed
Supports map switching



Hemlock:

Plummeter
+ Damage changed from (15 to 35) to (25 to 45)
+ Character-hit Downward velocity changed from 1350 to 1850
+ Added a slow effect to hit enemies (Reduces movement speed to 30% & Jump Height by 50%) for 3 seconds
Bleed
- Removed an accidental weakness to physical damage while under bleed

Summary: Hemlock should be in a overall way-better competitive strength after this change! Give him a try to counter those pesky Friday players :)


Charlie

 + Run speed at low health increased from 1150 to 1350
 + Run speed scaling changed from 0-100 HP to 0-150 HP (Gain speed sooner)
 + Brush-off calculation changed from 100% damage taken to 70% damage taken (Makes her tankier)
 + Energy Regen rate 20 -> 30 per tick

Staff Slam (Ability 3)

 - Reduced damage 60 to 45

Knock Out Punch (Ability 4)

 + Increased damage 60 to 65

Jab (Ability 1)

 - Reduced damage 40 to 35
 + Reduced energy cost 20 to 0

Summary: Charlie was intentionally designed to be weak, but I felt like she was a bit too squishy. I think the new (30%~) Damage mitigation should help her live longer, and with her energy cost adjustments there's now more choice in melee combat


Friday(Bunny)

 - Health changed from 90 to 80
 - Unarmed movement speed 1000 to 900 units per second
 - Weapon movement speed 800 to 700 units per second
 - Kick Damage 50 to 40

Heal Magnum:

 + 50 healing to 70 healing per shot

Summary: Friday was the strongest character in the game by a wide-margin. She needed nerfs, but I hoped to preserve her mobile play-style as that is the fun factor.


Abigail

 - Reduced ammo regen on TNT, Rifle, & Shotgun ammo by 50%
   Turrets
 - Removed the slight knock-back from turret shots
 - Damage 8 -> 6
 - Bullet Speed 10,000 -> 9,000 units per second
 + Build cost 150 -> 130 Pistol Ammo
 + Added a Red outline for enemy turrets within their firing range (3550)

Summary: Abigail was in an alright spot, maybe a bit on the strong side. These minor adjustments should keep her from becoming the true terror i believed her to be.


Ammo Boxes

 + Increased ammo in each box by roughly 50%



Bingo

 + In-combat stealth cost 35 -> 30 per second
 - Out of combat stealth cost 15 -> 20 per second
 + Energy regen 10 -> 15 per second
 + Max energy 100 -> 120
 + Starting energy 50 -> 80 

Summary: Bingo felt weak, after these changes he can effectively stay in stealth for 20 seconds (starting with full energy) should help him evade fire a bit better
